info.title: VegaDuta API
info.description: REST API of the VegaDuta agentic AI platform. Generated from the Spring controllers by OpenApiSpecGenerator; do not edit by hand. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details (application/problem+json) described by the Error schema; branch on its type or code, not on the message. Every response carries an X-Request-Id correlation header. Endpoints flagged x-sse stream Server-Sent Events. Where a handler builds its own ResponseEntity the exact 2xx status may differ from the documented one, so clients should accept any 2xx.

baseUrl.description: Your VegaDuta API origin, e.g. https://api.example.com (local Docker Compose: http://localhost:8080).

externalDocs.description: API conventions: errors, auth, paging, SDKs (docs/api/README.md)

post.description: Run one chat turn and stream the reply as Server-Sent Events: each event's data is the next text chunk. Send the same sessionId to continue a conversation; the server keeps the memory. Streams the response as Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream); each event's data field carries the next chunk.

Ask the in-flight chat turn of this session to stop; the turn ends on its next poll. Readable and changeable only by the caller who started the session: session memory is keyed by tenant + agent + user + client session id, so the same session id presented by any other caller resolves to nothing and answers 404.

Truncate the session transcript to its first keepTurns entries so the conversation continues from there; no turn is re-run. Readable and changeable only by the caller who started the session: session memory is keyed by tenant + agent + user + client session id, so the same session id presented by any other caller resolves to nothing and answers 404.

Readable and changeable only by the caller who started the session: session memory is keyed by tenant + agent + user + client session id, so the same session id presented by any other caller resolves to nothing and answers 404. put.description: Switch the conversation to another branch: the server lands on the newest leaf beneath the given message. Readable and changeable only by the caller who started the session: session memory is keyed by tenant + agent + user + client session id, so the same session id presented by any other caller resolves to nothing and answers 404. Requires the APP_CHAT_BRANCHING_ENABLED feature flag (app.chat.branching.enabled); when it is off this route answers 404.

post.description: Replace the text of an earlier user message on a new branch and stream the new reply; the original branch is kept. Readable and changeable only by the caller who started the session: session memory is keyed by tenant + agent + user + client session id, so the same session id presented by any other caller resolves to nothing and answers 404. Requires the APP_CHAT_BRANCHING_ENABLED feature flag (app.chat.branching.enabled); when it is off this route answers 404. Streams the response as Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream); each event's data field carries the next chunk.

get.description: The tenant's audit trail, newest first, filtered by actionType, targetType, actor, q and a from/to window. Without limit or offset: the newest 200. With limit: a page with X-Total-Count; follow X-Next-Cursor with cursor for deep history. Requires PERM_VIEW_AUDIT_LOG (or the tenant-admin role). Keyset paging: pass the X-Next-Cursor value of a page as cursor to get the next one; offset is ignored and X-Total-Count is not sent when cursor is given.

post.summary: Platform event delivered to a webhook subscription
post.description: POSTed to each enabled subscription whose event filter matches. The body is the WorkflowEvent envelope; payload is event-type specific. The test delivery (webhook.test) carries only eventType, tenantId, timestamp and payload. Documented event types: channel.whatsapp.message.received: Inbound WhatsApp message reached the platform. channel.sms.message.received: Inbound SMS reached the platform. channel.messenger.message.received: Inbound Facebook Messenger message. channel.instagram.message.received: Inbound Instagram DM. channel.slack.message.received: Inbound Slack message. channel.discord.message.received: Inbound Discord message. channel.x.message.received: Inbound X (Twitter) DM. channel.telegram.message.received: Inbound Telegram message. channel.email.message.received: Inbound email. channel.teams.message.received: Inbound Microsoft Teams message. workflow.run.started: A workflow run began executing. workflow.run.completed: A workflow run finished successfully. workflow.run.failed: A workflow run failed. workflow.run.cancelled: A workflow run was cancelled. workflow.run.resumed: A paused workflow run resumed. workflow.node.completed: A single workflow node finished (carries nodeId). workflow.output.emitted: A workflow's OUTPUT node produced a result. approval.requested: An action entered the human-approval queue. approval.resolved: An approval request was approved or rejected. approval.execution.recorded: An approved action's execution reached a terminal state. document.generation.completed: A document-generation job finished (COMPLETE or FAILED). agent.message.completed: An agent finished and persisted a reply (payload: agentId, sessionId, answerChars, answerExcerpt, source). webhook.test: Synthetic event sent by the Test button / POST .../test.

parameters.name: X-VegaDuta-Event
parameters.description: The event type of this delivery.

schema.description: Matches the body's eventType. The documented types are in examples; subscriptions may also name other exact types, "*" or "prefix.*".

parameters.name: X-VegaDuta-Delivery
parameters.description: Delivery id, stable across retries of the same delivery. Deliveries are at-least-once: store it and ignore a repeat.

parameters.name: X-VegaDuta-Signature
parameters.description: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" keyed with the subscription secret (whsec_...)>. Recompute it over the raw bytes, compare in constant time, and reject a t older than a few minutes to stop replays.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Any 2xx marks the delivery delivered; the body is ignored.

default.description: Any other status, a redirect, a timeout (5 s connect, 15 s total) or a connection error is retried with exponential backoff (30 s doubling, capped at 30 min) up to 10 attempts; then the delivery is dead. 25 dead deliveries in a row disable the subscription.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (RFC 9110, section 10.2.3).

X-Has-More.description: Sent by paged list endpoints when limit is given: true when rows remain beyond this page. See docs/api/LIST-ENDPOINT-PAGING.md.

X-Total-Count.description: Sent by paged list endpoints when limit is given: rows matching the filters before paging. See docs/api/LIST-ENDPOINT-PAGING.md.

X-Next-Cursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page, sent when more rows exist. Pass it back unchanged as the cursor query parameter.

ETag.description: Strong, opaque version of the resource (RFC 9110). Send it back in If-Match on a write to refuse it when the resource changed.

Deprecation.description: RFC 9745: the route is deprecated, as of @<unix seconds>. See docs/api/DEPRECATION.md.

Sunset.description: RFC 8594: HTTP-date after which the route may be removed.

RateLimit.description: Sent when app.rate-limit.api.enabled is on: "api";r=<remaining>;t=<seconds to reset> (IETF RateLimit header fields).

RateLimit-Policy.description: Sent when app.rate-limit.api.enabled is on: "api";q=<requests>;w=<window seconds>.

X-Request-Id.description: Correlation id for this request: the caller's own X-Request-Id when it sent a valid one, otherwise generated. Quote it in support requests.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a retry safe (IETF Idempotency-Key header): a repeat with the same key and body replays the first response (Idempotent-Replayed: true) for 24 hours; while the first is running a repeat gets 409, and the same key with a different body gets 422. Use a fresh random value (a UUID) per logical operation.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Optimistic concurrency (RFC 9110): the ETag from the resource's GET. The write is refused with 412 when the resource changed since; * always matches.

BadRequest.description: The request was malformed or failed validation.

Conflict.description: Conflicts with the current state, including a request whose Idempotency-Key is still being processed (type idempotency-key-in-use; retry after Retry-After).

Forbidden.description: The caller is authenticated but not allowed (permission, plan limit or locked resource).

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

PreconditionFailed.description: If-Match named no current version: the resource changed since it was read. Fetch it again (new ETag) and reapply the change.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded for this caller. Wait for Retry-After seconds before retrying.

UnprocessableEntity.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body (type idempotency-key-reused).

Error.description: Error body produced by ErrorResponseFactory: an RFC 9457 Problem Details object served as application/problem+json, which also keeps the legacy members (timestamp, error, code). With app.errors.problem-details.enabled=false only the legacy members are sent, as application/json. Some handlers add extension members (errors, budget, upstreamStatus, lockedReason ...); the gateway's own 401 may carry an empty body.

type.description: Stable, machine-readable problem type, e.g. urn:vegaduta:problem:agent-not-found. Branch on this, not on the message. Absent when problem details are switched off.

title.description: HTTP reason phrase of the status.

status.description: HTTP status code, repeated from the status line.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation; same text as error.

instance.description: Request path the problem occurred on (never the query string).

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, present only on handlers that disambiguate with one.

requestId.description: Correlation id, equal to the X-Request-Id response header.

traceId.description: OpenTelemetry trace id, when tracing is on.

apiKeyAuth.description: Long-lived grant key (prefix vmcp_) issued under /api/mcpserver/grants: Authorization: Bearer vmcp_...

tenantApiKey.description: Tenant REST API key (prefix vdak_) minted at /api/tenant/api-keys for server-to-server use: Authorization: Bearer vdak_... The key's stored PERM_* scopes are its authority set, so a route still answers 403 when the key lacks the permission.
